summary: The Catalog Community Sync notes for 1 July 2026 list three discussion items with links and record no outcomes. Alex and Sung brought the remote signing configuration pull request. Sung brought the question of fine-grained access control policies and field-id binding on schema change, with a mailing list thread and a document on co-committing access policy with schema changes in the Iceberg REST catalog. William brought file-level access delegation, which has its own mailing list thread.

topics.title: Remote signing configuration
topics.summary: Listed under Alex and Sung with a link to the pull request on remote signing configuration. The notes record no discussion or outcome.

topics.title: FGAC policies and field-id binding on schema change
topics.summary: Sung's item on how fine-grained access control policies bind to field ids when a schema changes. It links a mailing list thread and a document titled 'V1: Co-Committing Access Policy with Schema Changes in Iceberg REST Catalog'. The notes record no discussion or outcome.

topics.title: File-level access delegation
topics.summary: William's item on file-level access delegation, linked to its mailing list thread. The notes record no discussion or outcome.
